The system should have 3 roles: **Employee, Support Agent, and Admin**.


Core features:

* Employees can create support tickets with **title, description, category, priority, and attachment**.

* Admin can manage **users, categories, priorities, and tickets**.
* Provide **search, filtering, and dashboards** showing ticket count by status and priority.
* Add proper **mandatory-field validation, error messages, and success messages**.

* Create a clean, simple, enterprise-style UI.

Manage All Tickets → Edit existing ticket → STATUS changed Open → Assigned → validation → save

CREATE

Open

previous/existing status → requested/new status

Open → Assigned → In Progress → Resolved → Closed

Open → Assigned = VALID

plans.title: Sample data: support360_manage_ticket_queue
plans.description:
Fix the Admin ticket assignment/status workflow in Support360.

In Admin Setup → Manage All Tickets, an Admin must be able to take an existing ticket with status Open and assign it to an agent.

Current problem:

Existing tickets are created with status Open.
When Admin tries to change the status from Open → Assigned, the validation incorrectly shows: “A new ticket must be created with status 'Open', not 'Assigned'.”
When Admin tries to use Assign, it incorrectly shows: “Only tickets with status Open can be assigned (current status Assigned).”
This means the system is treating an existing ticket being assigned as if it were a new-ticket creation.

Required behavior:

Create Ticket: A newly created ticket must start with status Open.
Assign: An existing Open ticket can be assigned to an agent. The system must update its status from Open → Assigned and populate ASSIGNED_AGENT.
Reassign: An already Assigned ticket can be reassigned to another agent without triggering the new-ticket validation.
Start Progress: Assigned → In Progress.
Resolve: In Progress → Resolved, with any required resolution details.
Close/Confirm Close: Resolved → Closed.

Important: Do NOT apply the “new ticket must start as Open” validation when editing an existing ticket or executing the Assign action. That validation must apply only during ticket creation.

Please inspect the complete workflow and all related validations/business logic for:

support360_create_ticket
support360_manage_all_tickets
support360_manage_ticket_queue
validate_ticket_status_transition
Assign/Reassign actions

Identify the root cause of the conflicting validation rather than adding another workaround. Make the validation context-aware so it can distinguish CREATE from EDIT/ASSIGN.

Also ensure that the Assign action does not incorrectly see the ticket as already Assigned before the update is performed. The action should read the ticket's actual current status, validate that it is Open, then perform the update atomically.

Do not change the intended business workflow. Fix only the incorrect validation/state handling.

After making the changes, deploy them and run a regression test using an existing Open ticket:

Open ticket → Assign to Agent → Assigned → Start Progress → In Progress → Resolve → Resolved → Close → Closed

Do not consider the task complete if the code is only generated. Verify that the deployed runtime actually allows the Open → Assigned transition and that no “new ticket must be created with status Open” or “current status Assigned” error occurs.

If any validation or business logic prevents deployment/testing, identify the exact blocking component, fix it, redeploy, and continue testing rather than stopping after generating the code.
